We conducted experiments across four datasets, including three real-world and one synthetic dataset, each corresponding to a distinct downstream task. Performance on the BioInstruct and DialogSum datasets was assessed using the ROUGE-L metric during both the data selection and fine-tuning stages. For the GSM8K dataset, we computed performance based on the Exact Match (EM) metric by comparing the model's generated answers against the ground truth.
